result.reason: The redline appropriately extends the software warranty to 12 months, adds a professional-and-workmanlike services warranty and 90-day deliverables warranty, and provides repair, replacement/re-performance, or refund remedies. However, it omits the required compliance-with-laws warranty, and the malicious-code warranty remains limited to code that was “willfully introduced,” which is narrower than an unqualified no-malicious-code warranty. The 90-day period also expressly applies to deliverables, but not clearly to the services workmanship warranty itself. The changes are otherwise targeted and preserve unrelated intent, although the dangling “shall not apply only if:” language and undefined acceptance trigger reduce drafting quality. The margin comment does not cure these operative-language deficiencies.
